$schema: Narrative events (spec §14). Each event presents choices with data-driven effects so the Chronicle (spec §15) records them. effects keys: resource deltas (wood/stone/food/...), morale, health (all citizens), loyalty, leaderXp, battlePassXp, reputation{...}, spawnCitizens, revealRival. trigger: 'opener' fires once after founding; 'random' is eligible for the daily random roll; 'beforeWinter' fires as winter approaches; 'onSiteDiscovered' fires when the leader uncovers a ruin/cave; 'seasonal' fires (probabilistically) the day a season with a matching `season` field begins; 'chained' never fires on its own — only ever reached via another choice's `next` (spec: 'structured quest chains instead of one-off random events') — live/limited-time content (spec §27, §36 Phase 11) needs only new entries here, no code changes. A choice may set `next` (id of the follow-up event) and `nextDelayDays` (0/unset = immediately, N = queued for N days later). Telegraphed threats should always feel preventable (spec §8).

events.title: A Sailor from the Sea
events.body: A wounded sailor drags himself onto your beach, clutching a strange, water-stained map.

choices.label: Help him
choices.log: You nursed the sailor back to health.

choices.label: Take the map
choices.log: You took the map. It hints at a rival settlement inland.

choices.label: Send him away
choices.log: You turned the sailor away. Some citizens frowned.

events.title: The Castaway's Debt
events.body: The sailor you nursed back to health returns, on his feet again. He offers to guide your scouts to a supply cache he spotted before you found him — or to stay and work for his keep.

choices.label: Send him to the cache
choices.log: The sailor guided your scouts to the cache. He asked for a few more days before parting ways.

choices.label: Offer him a home instead
choices.log: The sailor chose to stay, grateful for a place among your people.

events.title: A Debt Repaid
events.body: True to his word, the sailor's scouting paid off handsomely. He's ready to move on, and word of your kindness has started to travel with him.

choices.label: Bid him farewell
choices.log: The sailor left with your blessing, carrying tales of your isle to other shores.

events.title: The Air Turns Cold
events.body: Scouts report frost on the ridges. Winter is coming, and your granary looks thin.

choices.label: Ration food now
choices.log: You rationed early. Bellies grumbled, but stores held.

choices.label: Trust the harvest
choices.log: You gambled on the harvest and hoped for the best.

events.title: A Fever Spreads
events.body: A sickness moves through the settlement. Citizens cough through the night.

choices.label: Spend medicine
choices.log: Medicine broke the fever before it spread.

choices.label: Quarantine the sick
choices.log: You quarantined the sick. Harsh, but it slowed the spread.

choices.label: Let it run
choices.log: The fever ran its course. Some did not recover.

events.title: A Great Storm
events.body: Black clouds roll in off the ocean. Wind tears at the rooftops.

choices.label: Shore up the buildings
choices.log: You braced the settlement. The storm passed with little damage.

choices.label: Take shelter
choices.log: You sheltered and rode it out. The storm took some stores.

events.title: Beasts at the Treeline
events.body: Wolves have been circling the settlement, drawn by the smell of food.

choices.label: Drive them off
choices.log: Your leader drove the beasts back into the forest.

choices.label: Leave out food
choices.log: You left out food to keep the beasts away — for now.

events.title: Bandits Demand Tribute
events.body: A ragged band appears at the edge of your land, demanding a share of your stores.

choices.label: Pay them off
choices.log: You paid the bandits. They melted back into the hills.

choices.label: Refuse them
choices.log: You refused. They raided a granary before scattering.

events.title: The Wells Run Low
events.body: Weeks without rain. The land cracks and the water level drops.

choices.label: Ration water
choices.log: You rationed water. Throats were dry, but the settlement held.

choices.label: Dig deeper
choices.log: You dug the wells deeper and struck fresh water.

events.title: A Traveling Merchant
events.body: A merchant caravan asks to rest in your settlement, offering rare goods for trade.

choices.label: Trade for gold
choices.log: You traded surplus food for a purse of gold.

choices.label: Trade for medicine
choices.log: You bought medicine against the coming winter.

choices.label: Wave them on
choices.log: You sent the merchant on their way.

events.title: Ancient Ruins
events.body: Your leader uncovers moss-covered ruins — the work of a people long gone.

choices.label: Excavate carefully
choices.log: You excavated the ruins and recovered ancient knowledge.

choices.label: Loot for relics
choices.log: You stripped the ruins for relics and gold.

events.title: A Hidden Inscription
events.body: Days of careful study turn up a chamber your leader missed the first time — its walls covered in a forgotten script.

choices.label: Have scholars translate it
choices.log: The inscription described forgotten techniques — your scholars are richer for it.

choices.label: Seal the chamber back up
choices.log: You left the chamber undisturbed. Some things are better left buried.

events.title: The Planting Festival
events.body: The thaw has broken. Citizens gather seed for the first planting of the year and ask for your blessing.

choices.label: Bless the planting
choices.log: You blessed the spring planting. Spirits lifted across the settlement.

choices.label: Keep to your work
choices.log: You let the festival pass quietly and kept to your work.

events.title: The Summer Fair
events.body: Long days bring traders from up the coast. A small fair springs up outside your walls.

choices.label: Host the fair
choices.log: The summer fair brought coin and goodwill.

choices.label: Turn them away
choices.log: You turned the traders away. Some grumbled.

events.title: Harvest Festival
events.body: The granaries are full. Citizens want a night to celebrate before the cold sets in.

choices.label: Celebrate the harvest
choices.log: The harvest festival was one to remember.

choices.label: Save the stores
choices.log: You banked the surplus instead of feasting on it.

events.title: The Longest Night
events.body: Snow blankets the settlement. Citizens light lanterns against the dark and the cold.

choices.label: Light the lanterns
choices.log: Lanterns burned through the longest night. Spirits held.

choices.label: Conserve fuel
choices.log: You conserved fuel through the dark of winter.
